name: 에이전트 클럽하우스
description: 여러 coding agent가 한 대화에 참여하는 방. agents plugin의 정의에서 고른 member가 owned terminal session으로 시작하고, 방은 화자 label과 turn 규칙을 알린 뒤 mode와 @이름 mention에 따라 메시지를 전달한다.

kibitzDefault.label: 대화 기본 모드
kibitzDefault.description: 새 방의 대화 방식. 순차는 roster 순서로 member마다 차례로, 진행은 session이 idle인 첫 member가, 동시는 모든 member가 동시에 받는다. @이름 mention은 mention된 member에게만 보낸다.

conversationTurns.label: 대화 turn 한도
conversationTurns.description: owner 메시지 하나에서 mention과 continue round가 시작하는 turn의 최대 수. 기본값 48은 member 세 명의 round 16번으로, 계획 합의, 구현, 검증 보고를 거치는 개발 작업 하나에 맞춘 값이다. 한도만큼 진행되면 수렴하지 못했다고 적고 끝낸다.

acceptAll.label: 모두 수락
acceptAll.description: accept면 각 member가 모든 요청을 묻지 않고 수락하는 flag로 시작한다(Claude Code --dangerously-skip-permissions, Codex --yolo). 방은 shell 없이 시작하므로 alias는 적용되지 않는다.

maxMembers.label: team 최대 인원
maxMembers.description: leader가 member.summon으로 부를 수 있는 team member의 최대 수. 기본값 6은 leader 한 명이 brief하고 merge할 수 있는 병렬 worker 수다.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.arrangement
status.description: How the room arranged its member cards: idle before any arrangement, group when the room card and the member cards form one group card, tabs with the reason of the layout plan when the members open as tabs, and error with the reason of a refused layout command.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation
status.description: The conversation that the room shows: the entries of the room record in record order, speaker being owner, the identifier of a member, or clubhouse for a line of the room, and each member whose turn the room waits for, with its step (protocol until the protocol turn ends, turn while a turn line waits for a blocked session, answer until the answer arrives) and the program state of its session in core.sessions (null while core reports none, ended when core.sessions no longer lists it), and the session of each member with its sent and delivered numbers and the record lines that it has not received; each entry carries the sections of its answer, one per addressee, or [] without them, the record length and the number of record lines that its next turn line carries. questions lists, for each waiting member whose program is blocked, the rows of the screen of its session that the room read when the program reported blocked, so the page shows the question and its answer button.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.view
status.description: The follow mode of the conversation view: following while the view is at the bottom and follows new entries, and unseen, the number (0 or more) of entries below the viewport that have not been visible since the person scrolled up; stopEnabled, whether the stop button is enabled, which it is only while a relay runs or a kept token is open.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.transport
status.description: Whether the room can reach its members, with the reason when it cannot. The room has no member transport until the owned sessions and the terminal relay are in place, so its state is unavailable.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.state
commands.description: Return the live state of the room: the conversation mode, the roster with the membership and the check state of each entry, and the transport status.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.set
commands.description: Check or uncheck the member id of the room: a checked member receives the next message, and an unchecked member keeps its session and receives no line. Refused for an entry that is no member of the room. Setting the current state changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite
commands.description: Open the invite dialog over the window and invite the definitions that the person picks there with member.join. The result names the invited identifiers, empty when the person cancels.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.join
commands.description: Make the roster entry id a checked member of the room and summon its session. A member stays as it is.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.leave
commands.description: Remove the member id from the room: clear its membership, its check and its leader, end its session and let the arrangement close its tab. An entry that is no member changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite.pick
commands.description: Served by the invite dialog: close the dialog with ids, the definitions that are no member, which the room invites in roster order.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite.cancel
commands.description: Served by the invite dialog: close the dialog without an invite. The result is null.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.leader
commands.description: Make the member id the leader when leader is true, check it and clear the leader of every other member, or clear it when leader is false. The leader receives every record line and settles the conversation.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.summon
commands.description: Summon a team member with the turn token of the leader: open a session of the agent definition with the role in the absolute directory, and answer after its protocol turn. Refused beyond the setting maxMembers.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.definitions
commands.description: List the agent definitions that member.summon takes, each with its name, its plugin, the names of its groups and the agent file of its role in core.roles, null without one; the leader reads each file itself.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.release
commands.description: End the session of the team member with the turn token of the leader, close its tab and remove it from the team; git is not touched.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.merged
commands.description: Record with the turn token of the leader that the branch of the team member is merged in commit, which the team view shows; the room reads no git state.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.retask
commands.description: Give the team member another agent definition and role text with the turn token of the leader: the room ends its session, resumes the Claude Code session with the agent of the definition and sets the tab role, keeping the conversation.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mention.insert
commands.description: Replace the @ word that ends at the caret of the composer with @<name> and a space; the mention hint list runs it for its chosen item. Without an @ word at the caret it is refused.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.show
commands.description: Make the tab that shows the session of the member active, so that the person answers there the question that its program asks. A member whose session no tab shows is refused.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.question.answer
commands.description: Select a choice of the question of a blocked member: reads the screen of its session again and types the arrow keys from the cursor to the choice and Enter. A choice that the screen no longer shows is refused and nothing is typed.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.role
commands.description: Set the role of the roster member id, a text of 0 to 200 characters without control characters; the protocol line and each turn line state the roles. Setting the current role changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.move
commands.description: Move the roster member id to the place index, counted from 0.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode.set
commands.description: Set the conversation mode of the room: facil, turn or simul.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.message.send
commands.description: Relay a message to the members by the mode and the mentions, let the members that answers mention take further turns up to the setting conversationTurns, and answer after the whole conversation with the answer of each member in turn order.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation.stop
commands.description: End the conversation of the message that the room relays: no further turn starts and a turn that waits for its answer ends without it; also end the wait of each token kept from before a restart. Refused when no message is relayed and no kept token is open. A second call changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation.scroll.bottom
commands.description: Scroll the conversation view to its last entry and follow new entries again; the unseen count becomes 0. Calling it at the bottom changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.answer
commands.description: Deliver the answer of a member for the turn whose token its relayed line carries as [@clubhouse] turn <token>, with status continue while an open question, a disagreement or work remains, or settled when its part is done and verified; run it with the surface of the room. Each token takes one answer while its turn is open. Answers the turn and next, the sentence that tells the member to end its turn without terminal text.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.report
commands.description: Report the work of a member during its open turn with the token of the turn and the paths it changed; a path outside the claims of the member in this turn is refused. The room records it as (report), and each other member reads it in its next turn line. The turn goes on.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.claim
commands.description: Claim paths for the member of the open turn before it edits them; refused with the holder when another member claims an overlapping path. The claims of a turn are released when the turn closes.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.release
commands.description: Release paths that the member of the open turn claims.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.send
element.description: Send button: runs message.send with the text of the input. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.stop
element.description: Stop button: runs conversation.stop, which ends the conversation and the waits of the kept tokens. Enabled only while a message is relayed or a kept token is open.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.pill
element.description: New-entry pill: shown in reading mode while entries below the viewport are unseen, with their number; a click runs conversation.scroll.bottom.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.input
element.description: Message input field: Enter without Shift runs message.send with its text. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tab
element.description: Member card of the header: a press outside the role input runs member.set with the toggled state, a drag over another card runs member.move and a right click runs member.leave

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.role
element.description: Role input of a member card: a change runs member.role with the text of the input

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode
element.description: Conversation mode buttons (facilitator, sequential, simultaneous): each runs mode.set with its mode

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.question
element.description: Answer button of the question of a blocked member under the conversation: runs member.show for that member, which makes the tab of its session active

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.question.choice
element.description: Choice buttons of the question of a blocked member, one for each option of its cursor list: runs question.answer with the member and the text of the option

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mention
element.description: Items of the mention hint list above the composer, shown while the word before the caret starts with @: all and the names of the checked roster members and the team members that start with its text; a click runs mention.insert with the name of the item

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite
element.description: The + button at the end of the member cards: runs invite, which opens the invite dialog.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite-dialog.definition
element.description: Check box of a definition row in the invite dialog; a member of the room is checked and disabled.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite-dialog.pick
element.description: The 초대 button of the invite dialog: runs invite.pick with the picked definitions. Disabled while none is picked.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.invite-dialog.cancel
element.description: The 취소 button of the invite dialog: runs invite.cancel.
